summary: One narrow required cover qualification (TKAM-R1). All 41 RU/EN pairs and all six effective cumulative routes were read. This is not a continuous full-edition fidelity certificate or publication approval.

editorialAssessment.form: PASS apart from TKAM-R1: concrete characters, actions, relationships, small comic reversals and accumulating danger carry the story; no substitute coaching, invented dialogue or compulsory moral.
editorialAssessment.nestedContinuity: Essential establishes the children, Radley mystery, defence, jail confrontation and contradictory testimony, stopping at the deliberation. Core inserts household/school and character episodes without broken antecedents. Deep continues from that pause into consequences and the converging Radley strand.
editorialAssessment.relationships: Scout/Jem/Atticus, Dill's neighbouring-aunt visit, Calpurnia's household role, Arthur/Boo and Nathan, Bob/Mayella and Tom/Helen are consistent with the consulted evidence. Francis is described as a cousin without an invented exact genealogy.
editorialAssessment.viewpointAndMeaning: Scout's uncertain perception during the attack and later recognition are preserved. The sheriff's account is attributed rather than certified as the forensic truth. Atticus, Jem, Maudie and Raymond retain their differing judgments within events. Racism, the rape charge, violence, loss and grief are not erased or turned into historical/clinical/scientific rules.
editorialAssessment.trialEvidence: Right-sided injuries, Tom's unusable left arm and Bob's left-handedness are a stated defence inference, not clinical proof of impossibility. Tom's version is attributed and does not claim he witnessed Bob beating Mayella.
editorialAssessment.endingEvidence: Threats, attack, rescue, recognition, protective sheriff account and porch/domestic return are supported within the guide boundary; primary chapter 29 passage checks the limited recollection/physical recognition. No complete primary chapters 30–31 reading is claimed.
editorialAssessment.quotations: The candidate contains no fabricated direct character quotations; selected genuine primary passages were checked against the source, not teacher prompts.
editorialAssessment.omissions: Full-edition texture and omitted subplots cannot be certified by this bounded evidence. Omission of, for example, the early Radley-door dare and exact final dialogue is acceptable condensation, not an invented missing-link blocker.

exactClause.ru: В зале суда их отец защищает человека, которого город уже осудил.
exactClause.en: In the courthouse their father defends a man the town has already judged.

requiredFindings.reason: The unqualified collective gives the town one settled judgment. The brief expressly forbids narrator-certified community consensus. The consulted evidence distinguishes hostility from many white residents, other white allies, and the Black community's support. This can be read as metonymy, but the requested safeguard requires a local qualifier; the narrative itself already uses 'many neighbours'. This is a narrow framing correction, not evidence that the story needs rebuilding.

minimumSupportedCorrection.ru: В зале суда их отец защищает Тома Робинсона, несмотря на враждебность многих белых соседей.
minimumSupportedCorrection.en: In the courthouse their father defends Tom Robinson despite hostility from many white neighbours.

sources.support: Describes many of the white community criticising Atticus for representing Tom.
Records the Black community's respect and food gifts, incompatible with town-wide agreement.
Explicitly qualifies the white opposition as many, but not all.

requiredFindings.repairScope: Parent may correct the two cover clauses personally, rebuild the collector HTML, refresh affected hashes and validate the changed clauses against these locations. No new scenes or change to 14/28/41 is requested.

exactClause.ru: Детям дарят на Рождество духовые ружья.
exactClause.en: The children receive air rifles for Christmas.

optionalObservations.suggestion: Core/Deep place this after the rabid-dog scene. An explicit backward glance ('На то Рождество…' / 'That Christmas they had received…') could make the compressed chronology smoother. The event itself is supported and there is no explicit claim of a second later Christmas; this is not a release blocker.

exactClause.ru: Ещё одним гостем становится сбежавший из дома Дилл.
exactClause.en: Another arrival is Dill, who has run away from home.

optionalObservations.observation: The submitted map points to DBE pp.58–59 for this whole beat; those pages explicitly cover his return, imaginative stories and family disinterest, but do not explicitly state flight from home. My direct reading of the public LitCharts chapter-14 account and Curt Southern's named eNotes account closes that narrow detail. Record the supplemental locator if updating the source ledger; no text deletion, invented scene or SOURCE-GAP verdict is warranted.
